text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser has an interview scheduled tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking it would be best to have a brief meeting beforehand, I head into my office only to find…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Canned mackerel!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: … Haaah! Canned crab, canned squid, canned curry! Cannelloni, cannonball, Canada!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is chanting what seems like some mysterious spell with intense concentration. All while wearing her signature racewear for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haha, sorry about that. You caught me right in the middle of my special chant for sharpening my focus.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I have an interview tomorrow, right? I wanted to be ready, so I looked up all the trendy new methods on how to concentrate.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Now then, the next method is… calligraphy! I'm off to grab some paper and ink!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! "It's a Doggy Dog World Out There"! Not too shabby, if I do say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun-mun… I can feel it now! The power of concentration is pulsing through my veins!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Two great masters were kind enough to teach me how to chant and do calligraphy, all for this moment.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I have to do them proud by acing the interview.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I can picture it in my head now. I'll definitely get questions like "What's your favorite food?" and "Are you a dog person or a cat person?"
choice_data_list: …Is wearing your signature racewear also one of your methods?
…Is wearing your signature racewear also one of your methods?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! I thought of this one myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: My signature racewear gives me more courage than anything else. It's precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: After all… it's proof that I was able to take a step forward despite being so average!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I may just be an ordinary Umamusume who got into this academy through luck, but when I got here, I made up my mind to work harder than anybody else!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Still, no matter how hard I tried, I always felt like I was the same ordinary girl I'd always been.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And that's when… something extraordinary happened!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: This signature racewear is proof that I can run in G1 races. In other words, it means my accomplishments are anything but ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, I was so thrilled when I first got this outfit! I called my family right away and sent some selfies to my friends back home.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Of course, I think getting my signature racewear was mostly just a stroke of luck, just like me getting into the academy at all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But being lucky matters. Fuku's always telling me that, and she's right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm lucky to have made so many friends I can work hard with. I'm lucky that I get to race against so many amazing runners who push me to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And above all, I'm lucky to have met you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe, glad we're on the same page! But geez, I can't believe I got us saying stuff like this. How embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, aaanyway… it feels like my signature racewear grants me this extraordinary power! So I'm gonna ace tomorrow's interview!
choice_data_list: Believe in yourself and go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right! I've totally got this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oooh! I can feel the special power of your words flowing into me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna tackle my interview tomorrow with this new power! That's a Machitan guarantee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here, let's make it official with a pinky promise! If I flub up, I'll drink a sea urchin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bursting with vigor and thoroughly focused, Matikanetannhauser attends her interview in perfect form.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oooh, are we doing it?! Okay, time for the usual cheer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna give that interview all I've got! Inhale…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Annnd! I'm gonna give every race all I've got—every single one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Muuun!
